content: Sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) transformations have recently proven to be a successful framework for several natural language processing tasks, like: machine translation (MT) BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , speech recognition BIBREF2 , speech synthesis BIBREF3 , natural language inference BIBREF4 and others. However, the success of these models depends on the availability of large amounts of directly annotated data for the task at hand (like translation examples, text segments and their speech recordings, etc.). This is a severe limitation for tasks where data is not abundantly available as well as for low-resource languages.
